XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity: All vehicles

  • System: - -

  • Device: Auxiliary belt

  • Fault: Auxiliary belt noise, accentuated during cold starts

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Faulty auxiliary belt / incorrect auxiliary belt tension

• Action: Check that the belt is in good condition and that the identification codes on the belt body are red . If this is the case, adjust the belt tension to a value between 30-35 daN

    If the identification codes on the belt body are not red , the belt must be replaced. After replacement, adjust the tension to a value between 48-60 daN

  • Procedure: - -

  • Notes: The tensioning procedure must always be carried out with the engine cold. Check the belt tension after turning the crankshaft 2 turns in the direction of rotation of the engine
